name: Repository Hub
tagline: Find every HelloWorld project, read about it, try its demo and browse its code
summary: The page you are on. It reads the HelloWorldIE GitHub account when it opens. Each project shows its pictures, guides, demo, README and code, and stands as a building in the City. Signed out, it shows public projects. Sign in with GitHub, or with a read-only token, to see the private ones.
features: Walk through the City, where each project is a building and its files are the streets around it
Find a project by category, kind, status or the tools it uses
Follow every project along the line from idea to live
Open a project's demo in a sealed frame, and follow its step-by-step guides
Read the README and browse the code
See which repos still need a README, a hub card or a demo
no_demo: The hub is itself live at its own address.
